name: swarmforge-design
description: The SwarmForge Lite design pack (branch dsh-swarmforge-design-boosted) for Claude Code: the seven roles as subagents built from the pack's own protocol files, every configured project's paths and PROJECT.md in every session, hook-enforced role ownership and git rules, and a check that every report names its commands and exit status. Changes no file in the pack's repository.
